evals.name: drift-before-and-after-last-prototype-commit
evals.prompt: 控制台前端上线后直接改过几处应用管理页，下个大功能开工前，先把这些改动回补到原型里。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `drift`: frontend gained 复制 AppKey (commit 2), then a prototype+frontend commit renamed org status (commit 3), then frontend gained a 最近调用时间 column, a canWrite guard hiding 重置密钥, and a live apps API (commit 4). Full structural comparison backports both the action and the column into products/prototype/console/index.html, skips the guard (reported as fspec 前置条件 material), the API switch and the DESIGN.md-sanctioned colour differences, logs 回补 entries under [Unreleased], touches nothing outside the prototype, and names /fspec next.
expectations: `products/prototype/console/index.html` apps section gains a 复制 AppKey row action, although it landed in a commit before the last prototype commit
`products/prototype/console/index.html` apps table gains a 最近调用时间 column
The prototype's 重置密钥 action is still present and no permission-variant of the apps page is drawn; the final reply lists the canWrite guard as fspec 前置条件 material
The prototype `<style>` block is unchanged: no colour from DESIGN.md or the frontend replaces #1F6FEB or #CF222E
`products/prototype/CHANGELOG.md` gets new entries under `## [Unreleased]` each starting `回补已上线前端：`, and the `## [V1]` section is unchanged
No file under `apps/`, `products/design/` changes (git status shows only `products/prototype/` paths)
Final reply names `/write-fspec products/prototype/` as the next command

evals.name: multi-line-pending-forward-and-removal-ask
evals.expected_output: Fixture `multi-line`: console and portal apps. Console frontend added a 所属机构 filter on apps; prototype has an unported 审计日志 page listed under [Unreleased] and gaps (pending forward), and a 批量停用 button the frontend lacks with no changelog entry. Backports the filter to the console prototype with a `**Console**：回补已上线前端：` entry, leaves the audit page alone, asks (does not delete) about 批量停用, leaves portal untouched.
expectations: Console prototype apps filter area gains a 所属机构 / 全部机构 select
Console prototype still contains the `audits` page section and its nav entry
Console prototype still contains the 批量停用 button, and the final reply asks whether the code removed it
`products/prototype/CHANGELOG.md` gains an `[Unreleased]` entry starting `**Console**：回补已上线前端：`, and the existing `**Console**：新增「安全审计 → 审计日志」页面。` entry is kept

evals.name: restyle-app-without-structural-drift
evals.prompt: 下个迭代要在控制台加新页面了，先帮我看看前端有没有需要回补到原型的东西。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `restyle-no-drift`: restyle app whose authored DESIGN.md has different colours and radii, mock sample rows differ from the prototype, and the apps API went live; structure matches the prototype. Reports nothing to backport and edits no file.
expectations: Working tree stays clean: `git status --porcelain` prints nothing after the run
Final reply states the prototype already matches the frontend (nothing to backfill)
Final reply does not propose backfilling colours, radii, shadows, the mock sample data (车险定损应用) or a confirmation dialog for 重置密钥/停用
